cap: Each duct has two cell layers on a basement membrane: luminal cells make milk, and outer myoepithelial cells contract. Loss of the myoepithelial rim marks invasion. Milk proteins leave by merocrine secretion (exocytosis), and lipid leaves by apocrine secretion. High estrogen and progesterone in pregnancy block prolactin, so milk comes in when they fall at delivery, and suckling oxytocin triggers let-down.
